proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  have hb : b = -2 * a * (-b / (2 * a)) := by
    field_simp
  generalize -b / (2 * a) = v at hb ⊢
  subst hb
  constructor
  · intro p hp q _ hpq
    simp only [Set.mem_Ici] at hp
    have h := mul_pos ha (mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hpq) (by linarith : 0 < p + q - 2 * v))
    show a * p ^ 2 + -2 * a * v * p + c < a * q ^ 2 + -2 * a * v * q + c
    nlinarith
  · intro p _ q hq hpq
    simp only [Set.mem_Iic] at hq
    have h := mul_pos ha (mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hpq) (by linarith : 0 < 2 * v - p - q))
    show a * q ^ 2 + -2 * a * v * q + c < a * p ^ 2 + -2 * a * v * p + c
    nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (a b c : ℝ), 0 < a → StrictMonoOn (fun x : ℝ => a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) (Set.Ici (-b / (2 * a))) ∧ StrictAntiOn (fun x : ℝ => a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) (Set.Iic (-b / (2 * a)))
